skill.summary: This skill should be used when the user requests comprehensive research, deep investigation, or detailed academic-style reports on any topic. Trigger phrases...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial version of the deep-research skill, enabling rigorous, comprehensive academic-style investigation.

- Produces multi-thousand word markdown reports with extensive citations.
- Emphasizes thoroughness, accuracy, and source verification—prioritizing rigor over speed.
- Implements a strict research workflow: topic decomposition, detailed planning, systematic multilingual web search, and critical analysis.
- Requires direct access to full web pages (not just snippets) and evaluation of source credibility.
- Encourages multi-lingual searches and cross-referencing to overcome information silos and biases.
